target.definition: China's total retail sales of consumer goods (社会消费品零售总额) for the single month of April 2026, as first reported by the National Bureau of Statistics of China.

inputs.name: annual_retail_sales_2025
inputs.description: China's total retail sales of consumer goods in calendar year 2025

provenance.rationale: 2024 was about 48.8 trillion CNY; modest nominal growth puts 2025 near 50 trillion.

inputs.name: april_share_of_year
inputs.description: Share of annual retail sales falling in April (a low-season month, ~30 days)

provenance.rationale: April is a normal 30-day month with no major holiday spike; roughly 1/13 of the year.

inputs.name: april_seasonal_factor
inputs.description: April sales relative to an average month

provenance.rationale: April lacks Spring Festival and Golden Week boosts, so slightly below average.

inputs.name: yoy_nominal_growth
inputs.description: Year-on-year nominal growth of retail sales in April 2026

provenance.rationale: Recent monthly growth has been low single digit; trade-in programs fading.

inputs.name: april_2025_retail_sales
inputs.description: Retail sales in April 2025 (base for year-on-year growth)

provenance.rationale: April 2025 was around 3.7 trillion CNY based on recent monthly levels.
Population peaked near 1.41 billion and is slowly declining.

inputs.name: monthly_retail_spend_per_capita
inputs.description: Average monthly retail spending per person in China

provenance.rationale: Annual per-capita retail spend ~35,000 CNY divided by 12.

inputs.name: april_per_capita_factor
inputs.description: April per-capita spending relative to an average month

provenance.rationale: 2024 GDP was about 134.9 trillion CNY; ~4% nominal growth.

inputs.name: retail_to_gdp_ratio
inputs.description: Ratio of annual retail sales to GDP

provenance.rationale: Retail sales have hovered around 35-37% of GDP in recent years.

inputs.name: april_share_of_year_proxy
inputs.description: April's share of annual retail sales used in the proxy path

paths.description: Allocate 2025 annual retail sales to April using April's share of the year
Population times per-capita monthly retail spend, adjusted for April seasonality
Scale GDP by retail-to-GDP ratio and April's share of the year
